tracks.title: Search & IR
tracks.description: Lexical retrieval beyond embeddings: tokenization, inverted indexes, BM25, ranking, hybrid search, and search evaluation.

tracks.title: Mathematics
tracks.description: Active math only: solve, derive, implement, simulate — never aesthetic consumption. Stack: probability & statistics → linear algebra → optimization → quant bridge. No artifact, no learning.

tracks.title: Vector DB & ANN
tracks.description: Vector search engines: similarity, top-k, brute force, HNSW, IVF, quantization, metadata filtering, and recall/latency tradeoffs.

tracks.title: AI Systems
tracks.description: Practical AI engineering: LLM apps, RAG, chunking, tool calling, agents, evals, and model/transformer foundations.

tracks.title: Backend
tracks.description: Production backend strength: HTTP, API design, auth, rate limiting, idempotency, queues, jobs, caching, and observability.

tracks.title: Databases & Storage
tracks.description: Storage foundations for Turbopuffer-class systems: B-trees, LSM trees, WAL, compaction, partitioning, replication, object storage.

tracks.title: System Design
tracks.description: Architecture-level thinking: low-level design, scalability, distributed systems, event-driven design, and end-to-end case studies.

tracks.title: DSA & Implementation
tracks.description: Fast, clean implementation ability: arrays, graphs, trees, dynamic programming, and the core algorithmic patterns.

tracks.title: Behavioral & Communication
tracks.description: The interview round that is not about code: influence, conflict, ownership, prioritisation, and learning from failure.

tracks.title: Go-to-Market
tracks.description: Getting a built thing in front of people: positioning, landing pages, SEO, and product analytics.

tracks.title: Systems Foundations
tracks.description: Operating systems, networks, concurrency, hardware, runtimes, performance, security, and isolation.

tracks.title: Infrastructure & Platforms
tracks.description: Cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, orchestration, reliability, observability, sandboxes, and infrastructure automation.

tracks.title: Distributed Systems
tracks.description: Coordination, replication, partitioning, event systems, caching, durable workflows, consistency, and recovery.

tracks.title: Inference & Serving
tracks.description: Inference engines, batching, KV caches, attention kernels, decoding, routing, hardware utilization, and serving economics.

tracks.title: Agent Systems
tracks.description: Agent loops, tools, memory, MCP, coordination, durable execution, permissions, computer use, and long-running work.

tracks.title: Evaluation & AI Reliability
tracks.description: LLM and agent evaluations, regression gates, failure detection, tracing, verification, human review, and quality economics.

tracks.title: Developer Tools & Code Intelligence
tracks.description: Code review, analysis, testing infrastructure, repository graphs, coding agents, supply-chain health, and remediation.

tracks.title: Application Engineering
tracks.description: Backend, web, mobile, product analytics, UX, real-time applications, interactive systems, and distribution loops.

tracks.title: Multimodal & Spatial Computing

roadmaps.title: 9-Day Reset
roadmaps.goal: Rebuild learning momentum by taking one concept all the way to a shipped artifact.

roadmaps.title: 30-Day Retrieval Basics
roadmaps.goal: Build a solid foundation in both lexical and vector retrieval, ending with hybrid search.

roadmaps.title: 90-Day AI Search & Infrastructure
roadmaps.goal: Build a strong retrieval, vector, AI-systems, and storage foundation through HighSignal and Codevetter.

roadmaps.title: 12-Month Advanced AI Infrastructure
roadmaps.goal: Reach the depth to design and reason about systems like Turbopuffer, and ship them through HighSignal and Codevetter.

roadmaps.title: Disk-First Databases & RAM
roadmaps.goal: Build a mechanism-first mental model of how disk-based DBs spend RAM, and why.

roadmaps.title: Runtime — what every runtime has to do
roadmaps.goal: Build one cross-cutting mental model for V8, JVM, Go, BEAM, .NET CLR, vLLM, SGLang, Cloudflare Workers, and wasmtime.

roadmaps.title: The Software Engineering Landscape (2026)
roadmaps.goal: Get a working mental model of every major systems-software domain — LLMs, DBs, streaming, game engines, containers, browsers, compilers, OS, networking, distributed, build, crypto.

roadmaps.title: LLD Practice
roadmaps.goal: Build the design-rounds muscle: model state and behaviour explicitly, justify every class boundary.

roadmaps.title: HLD Practice
roadmaps.goal: Be able to design X — feed, chat, ride-hailing, search — under a 45-minute clock with credible numbers.

roadmaps.title: DSA Practice
roadmaps.goal: Solve canonical patterns from scratch — no references, explain the invariant, add one edge-case test.

roadmaps.title: 30-Day Math Rating Climb
roadmaps.goal: Raise your per-roadmap ELO by climbing from linear algebra through statistics to calculus — each week unlocks harder drills at your edge.

roadmaps.title: 30-Day Probability & Statistics
roadmaps.goal: Active probability & statistics — solve, derive, implement. No passive video watching as a substitute for problems.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Active Math Stack
roadmaps.goal: Math → AI systems → distributed/data → quant tools. Active only: solve, derive, implement, simulate — never aesthetic consumption.

roadmaps.title: Behavioral Practice
roadmaps.goal: Have a STAR-shaped story for every Amazon-style leadership principle, with one self-aware "what I would do differently".

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Systems Foundations
roadmaps.goal: Build a mechanism-first model from hardware and kernels through runtimes, networks, performance, and isolation.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Infrastructure & Platforms
roadmaps.goal: Design and operate a reproducible, observable, fault-tolerant platform for untrusted workloads.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Distributed Systems
roadmaps.goal: Reason about coordination, data placement, logs, durable workflows, consistency, and recovery under partial failure.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week AI Models & Training
roadmaps.goal: Move from transformer foundations through pre-training, fine-tuning, post-training, compression, and evaluation.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Inference & Serving
roadmaps.goal: Build a production mental model for inference engines, memory, kernels, routing, hardware, and serving economics.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Agent Systems
roadmaps.goal: Engineer useful agents with bounded loops, tools, memory, protocols, durability, permissions, and long-running control.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Evaluation & AI Reliability
roadmaps.goal: Build an evidence-backed evaluation and observability system for models, tools, and agents.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Developer Tools & Code Intelligence
roadmaps.goal: Build repository-aware tools that analyze, test, review, debug, and safely remediate code.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Application Engineering
roadmaps.goal: Turn backend, client, UX, real-time, interactive, analytics, and distribution skills into one complete product.

roadmaps.title: 12-Week Multimodal & Spatial Computing
roadmaps.goal: Connect vision, audio, generation, on-device intelligence, robotics, spatial interfaces, and HCI.

roadmaps.title: Trace a Tensor
roadmaps.goal: Follow one model workload from representation and gradients to memory, kernels, scheduling, and serving economics.

roadmaps.title: Harness Engineering
roadmaps.goal: Design, build, verify, and evaluate the environment around a coding agent so it can make reliable progress across bounded and long-running tasks.

concepts.name: Tokenization
concepts.description: Splitting text into terms: lowercasing, stemming, stop words, n-grams.

concepts.name: Inverted Index
concepts.description: Term → posting list mapping that powers fast keyword lookup.

concepts.name: TF-IDF
concepts.description: Term frequency × inverse document frequency weighting for relevance.

concepts.name: BM25
concepts.description: The standard lexical ranking function: TF saturation + IDF + length normalization.

concepts.name: Ranking Metrics
concepts.description: Precision, recall, MRR, and nDCG for measuring retrieval quality.

concepts.name: Search Evals
concepts.description: Building a labelled query set and harness to compare retrieval approaches.

concepts.name: Hybrid Search
concepts.description: Fusing lexical (BM25) and vector retrieval, usually via reciprocal rank fusion.

concepts.name: Reranking
concepts.description: A second-stage cross-encoder pass that reorders the top-k candidates.

concepts.name: Query Rewriting
concepts.description: Expanding, correcting, and normalizing queries before retrieval.

concepts.name: Search Systems
concepts.description: Inverted index, ranking, autocomplete at scale.

concepts.name: Embeddings
concepts.description: Mapping text/images into dense vectors where distance encodes meaning.

concepts.name: Vector Similarity
concepts.description: Cosine, dot product, and L2 distance — how to score vector closeness.

concepts.name: Top-k Vector Search
concepts.description: Returning the k nearest vectors to a query, exact or approximate.

concepts.name: Brute-Force Vector DB
concepts.description: Exact nearest-neighbour search by scanning every vector — the correctness baseline.

concepts.name: HNSW
concepts.description: Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs — the dominant ANN index.

concepts.name: IVF (Inverted File)
concepts.description: Cluster vectors with k-means, then search only the nearest cells (nprobe).

concepts.name: Product Quantization
concepts.description: Compress vectors into sub-space codebooks for tiny memory footprint.

concepts.name: Metadata Filtering
concepts.description: Combining vector search with structured predicates (tenant, date, tags).

concepts.name: Recall / Latency Tradeoffs
concepts.description: Reading recall-vs-latency curves to choose ANN parameters.

concepts.name: RAG
concepts.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: ground an LLM answer in retrieved context.

concepts.name: Chunking
concepts.description: Splitting documents into retrievable units that preserve meaning.

concepts.name: Context Packing
concepts.description: Ordering and budgeting retrieved context within the model's window.

concepts.name: Structured Outputs
concepts.description: Forcing LLM output into a validated JSON schema.

concepts.name: Tool Calling
concepts.description: Letting an LLM invoke functions/APIs via structured calls.

concepts.name: Agent Loops
concepts.description: The plan → act → observe loop, with memory and stopping conditions.

concepts.name: Model Routing
concepts.description: Sending each request to the cheapest model that can handle it.

concepts.name: Prompt & Version Logging

concepts.name: LLM Evals

concepts.name: IDE & CLI Tooling

concepts.name: Coding Agent Systems
concepts.description: Repository context, planning, file edits, tools, tests, sandboxes, review loops, and patch delivery.

concepts.name: Repository Intelligence

concepts.name: Voice & Audio Systems

concepts.name: Image & Video Generation
concepts.description: Diffusion and transformer generation, conditioning, latent spaces, control, consistency, safety, and media evaluation.

concepts.name: Robotics Systems

concepts.name: Spatial Interfaces
concepts.description: Coordinate systems, anchors, tracking, depth, occlusion, hand/eye input, world understanding, and spatial UI.

concepts.name: Human-Computer Interaction
concepts.description: Human perception, cognition, motor control, interaction techniques, accessibility, evaluation, and responsible design.

concepts.name: Complexity Analysis
concepts.description: Big-O, amortised cost, and space complexity — how to argue a bound before writing code.

concepts.name: Sorting
concepts.description: Comparison sorts, stability, in-place versus extra space, and when a linear-time sort is available.

concepts.name: Capacity Estimation
concepts.description: Back-of-the-envelope QPS, storage, and bandwidth maths that sizes a design before you draw it.

concepts.name: Requirements Scoping
concepts.description: Separating functional from non-functional requirements and cutting scope to something buildable.

concepts.name: Prefix Sums
concepts.description: Precomputed cumulative arrays that turn repeated range queries into O(1) lookups.

concepts.name: Monotonic Stack
concepts.description: A stack kept sorted so each element is pushed and popped once, answering next-greater questions in O(n).

concepts.name: String Matching
concepts.description: Finding a pattern in text in linear time — KMP's failure function and Rabin-Karp's rolling hash.

concepts.name: Minimum Spanning Tree
concepts.description: Kruskal and Prim — connecting every node at least total cost.

concepts.name: Isolation Levels & MVCC

concepts.name: Join Algorithms
concepts.description: Nested-loop, hash, and merge joins — and why cardinality estimates decide which one you get.

concepts.name: Retries & Circuit Breakers
concepts.description: Backoff, jitter, budgets, and breakers — retrying without turning a blip into an outage.

concepts.name: Web Security Basics
concepts.description: XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, and CORS — the injection and confused-deputy bugs that keep recurring.

concepts.name: Queueing Theory
concepts.description: Little's law and the utilisation curve — why latency explodes before a system runs out of capacity.

concepts.name: Curse of Dimensionality
concepts.description: Why distances concentrate in high dimensions, and what that does to nearest-neighbour search.

concepts.name: Top-k Pruning (WAND)
concepts.description: WAND, MaxScore, and block-max — skipping documents that cannot reach the top k.

concepts.name: Rate Limiter Design
concepts.description: Token bucket versus sliding window, and making a limiter work across many nodes.

concepts.name: Unique ID Generation
concepts.description: Snowflake, ULID, and UUIDv7 — unique ids without a central allocator.

concepts.name: Recursion & Induction
concepts.description: Writing recursion you can trust, and solving the recurrence it produces.

concepts.name: Quickselect
concepts.description: Finding the k-th smallest in expected O(n) by recursing into only one partition.

concepts.name: Normalization
concepts.description: Functional dependencies, 1NF through BCNF, and the cases where denormalising is right.

concepts.name: Buffer Pool
concepts.description: The database's own page cache — why it does not simply trust the OS.

concepts.name: Pagination
concepts.description: Offset versus cursor pagination, stable ordering, and why deep pages get expensive.

concepts.name: Combinatorics
concepts.description: Counting without enumerating — permutations, combinations, inclusion-exclusion, pigeonhole.

concepts.name: Numerical Stability
concepts.description: Floating point, catastrophic cancellation, and the log-sum-exp trick.

concepts.name: Learning to Rank
concepts.description: Pointwise, pairwise, and listwise objectives — and why the metric you care about is not differentiable.

concepts.name: Click Models & Position Bias
concepts.description: Why clicks are not relevance labels, and how to debias implicit feedback.

concepts.name: Scalar & Binary Quantization
concepts.description: Shrinking vectors to int8 or single bits, and rescoring to recover the lost precision.

concepts.name: Disk-Based ANN
concepts.description: DiskANN and SPANN — serving vector indexes that do not fit in memory.

concepts.name: Index Updates & Tombstones
concepts.description: Deleting and updating vectors in a graph index without rebuilding it.

concepts.name: CDN & Edge Delivery
concepts.description: Cache hierarchy, origin shield, and invalidation versus TTL at the edge.

concepts.name: Data Representation
concepts.description: Binary and hexadecimal, two's complement, IEEE-754 floating point, Unicode, byte order, and serialized bytes.

concepts.name: Program Memory Model
concepts.description: Pointers, stack frames, heap allocation, object lifetime, executable loading, and the transition from a program on disk to a running process.

concepts.name: Repository Instruction Topology
concepts.description: Repository-wide and path-local instructions, precedence, ownership boundaries, and concise executable guidance for coding agents.

concepts.name: Agent Environment Contracts
concepts.description: Deterministic bootstrap, dependency and runtime discovery, readiness probes, isolated workspaces, and explicit validation commands.

concepts.name: Agent Work State & Handoffs
concepts.description: Versioned goals, plans, checkpoints, evidence, blockers, and next actions that let a new session resume without relying on hidden conversational memory.

concepts.name: Agent Scope Control
concepts.description: Bounded task decomposition, allowed edit roots, budgets, change-size limits, and escalation when evidence invalidates the plan.

concepts.name: Independent Agent Verification

concepts.name: Agent Run Lifecycle
concepts.description: Run initialization, leases and heartbeats, progress transitions, budgets, completion evidence, cancellation, escalation, and safe termination.

concepts.name: Harness Evaluation
concepts.description: Task suites, outcome rubrics, trajectory metrics, cost and latency budgets, ablations, and regression gates for the harness rather than the model alone.

systemDesignCases.title: Design LLM inference at 10K RPS
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a production LLM inference service that sustains 10,000 requests per second. Explain how you turn that headline into capacity, architecture, overload, and reliability decisions.
systemDesignCases.pattern: token-aware accelerator scheduling
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: admission through continuous batching to streamed decode

systemDesignCases.title: Design production RAG
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design retrieval-augmented generation over a large, frequently changing document corpus with permissions and citations.
systemDesignCases.pattern: fresh permission-aware retrieval augmentation
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: authorized hybrid retrieval through grounded generation

systemDesignCases.title: Design a multi-tenant LLM gateway
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an API gateway in front of multiple LLM models and providers for thousands of tenants.
systemDesignCases.pattern: budgeted multi-provider model routing
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: tenant admission through provider streaming and accounting

systemDesignCases.title: Design real-time recommendations
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a real-time recommendation service for a large consumer application.
systemDesignCases.pattern: online candidate retrieval and ranking
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: fresh features through retrieve-rank-serve

systemDesignCases.title: Design a URL shortener
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a global URL-shortening service with custom aliases, analytics, expiration, and abuse controls.
systemDesignCases.pattern: compact identifier allocation for read-heavy redirects
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: short-code lookup to low-latency redirect

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed rate limiter
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a global, multi-tenant rate limiter for an API gateway with burst allowances and regional enforcement.
systemDesignCases.pattern: distributed quota enforcement under clock and region skew
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: atomic allowance decision before protected work

systemDesignCases.title: Design real-time chat
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design real-time one-to-one and group chat for 50 million daily active users.
systemDesignCases.pattern: durable ordered messaging over long-lived connections
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: connected send through durable fan-out and acknowledgement

systemDesignCases.title: Design a ranked news feed
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a ranked home feed for 100 million users with celebrity accounts, freshness, and moderation.
systemDesignCases.pattern: hybrid social fan-out with policy-aware ranking
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: candidate assembly through filtering ranking and cursor delivery

systemDesignCases.title: Design a video streaming platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an on-demand video platform for creator uploads and global playback. Focus on the reusable upload, transcode, package, authorize, and CDN-delivery pattern rather than recommendations.
systemDesignCases.pattern: adaptive bitrate media processing and edge delivery
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: immutable manifest publication through CDN-backed adaptive playback

systemDesignCases.title: Design a photo-sharing platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an Instagram-like photo-sharing service with uploads, transformations, privacy, feeds, likes, and safe deletion. Focus on media and social-delivery boundaries.
systemDesignCases.pattern: privacy-aware social media processing and delivery
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: authorized media upload processing and CDN delivery with deletion propagation

systemDesignCases.title: Design a collaborative document editor
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a Google Docs-like editor with real-time multi-user edits, offline work, presence, history, permissions, and deterministic convergence.
systemDesignCases.pattern: convergent offline-capable replicated editing
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: causally tracked document operations through durable convergence and snapshots

systemDesignCases.title: Design a notification delivery service
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design push, email, SMS, and in-app notification delivery with user preferences, priorities, quotas, retries, provider failure, and duplicate control.
systemDesignCases.pattern: preference-aware multi-channel fan-out with provider isolation
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: durable intent through policy rendering and deduplicated provider delivery

systemDesignCases.title: Design a web crawler
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a web-scale crawler that discovers, fetches, deduplicates, stores, and recrawls useful pages while obeying robots policy and host politeness.
systemDesignCases.pattern: polite distributed URL frontier and recrawl scheduling
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: priority plus per-host eligibility through bounded fetch and deduplication

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed cache
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a low-latency distributed cache with partitioning, replication, TTL, eviction, invalidation, node failure, hot keys, and stampede protection.
systemDesignCases.pattern: partitioned volatile key-value serving with bounded stampede recovery
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: consistent key routing through eviction replication and miss collapse

systemDesignCases.title: Design search autocomplete
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design typeahead suggestions for a large search product with prefix lookup, ranking, trends, personalization, freshness, moderation, and low latency.
systemDesignCases.pattern: low-latency prefix retrieval with freshness safety and ranking
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: normalized prefix lookup through top-k ranking inside a keystroke budget

systemDesignCases.title: Design cloud file storage
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design Dropbox or Google Drive-style file synchronization with resumable uploads, folders, sharing, versions, offline conflicts, durability, and efficient transfer.
systemDesignCases.pattern: content-addressed chunk synchronization with versioned metadata
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: resumable missing-chunk transfer followed by atomic metadata version commit

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed key-value store
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a Dynamo-style distributed key-value store with partitioning, replication, tunable consistency, durability, rebalancing, repair, and compaction.
systemDesignCases.pattern: replicated partitioned durable key-value state
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: partition routing through quorum durability conflict repair and compaction

systemDesignCases.title: Design a ride-sharing platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an Uber or Lyft-style marketplace with driver locations, nearby matching, dispatch offers, atomic trip assignment, live trip state, ETA, and regional spikes.
systemDesignCases.pattern: geospatial moving-supply matching with atomic assignment
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: fresh driver location index through bounded offer and trip assignment

systemDesignCases.title: Design a ticket-booking platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design Ticketmaster-style reserved-seat booking with event browse, a virtual waiting room, expiring holds, payments, oversell prevention, bots, and flash crowds.
systemDesignCases.pattern: scarce inventory holds with idempotent purchase reconciliation
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: atomic seat hold through ambiguous payment to confirmed order

systemDesignCases.title: Design a payment-processing system
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a payment system with authorization, capture, refunds, idempotency, webhooks, an auditable ledger, processor timeouts, reconciliation, and fraud controls.
systemDesignCases.pattern: idempotent payment state machine backed by an immutable double-entry ledger
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: authorization through durable ledger posting settlement and reconciliation

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed unique ID generator
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a service that issues globally unique, roughly time-sortable 64-bit IDs to thousands of application servers across regions without a database round trip per ID.
systemDesignCases.pattern: time-ordered identifier allocation without a central write bottleneck
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: local ID generation from timestamp, worker identity, and per-tick sequence

systemDesignCases.title: Design a proximity search service
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a service that returns open businesses within a radius, filtered by category and ranked by distance, for a global consumer application.
systemDesignCases.pattern: geospatial candidate generation followed by exact distance filtering
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: write location to spatial cells, retrieve nearby candidates, then rank exact distances

systemDesignCases.title: Design a nearby friends service
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an opt-in feature that shows which friends are nearby and updates within seconds as people move, while making privacy and battery cost first-class constraints.
systemDesignCases.pattern: privacy-filtered moving-presence fan-out over spatial subscriptions
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: ingest a moving user location, update spatial presence, and notify authorized nearby friends

systemDesignCases.title: Design a maps and routing platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a driving-directions service that returns routes and ETAs across a continent, incorporates live traffic, and can serve map tiles separately from route computation.
systemDesignCases.pattern: hierarchical shortest-path routing over a versioned road graph
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: snap endpoints to the road graph, search a partitioned hierarchy, and assemble route guidance

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed message queue
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a multi-tenant distributed queue for asynchronous jobs and event streams with durable retention, consumer groups, backpressure, and at-least-once delivery.
systemDesignCases.pattern: partitioned durable log with consumer-owned progress and bounded redelivery
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: append to an ordered partition, replicate, acknowledge, fetch, and advance consumer progress

systemDesignCases.title: Design a metrics monitoring platform
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a multi-tenant metrics platform that ingests counters, gauges, and histograms, supports dashboard queries and recording rules, and evaluates reliable alerts.
systemDesignCases.pattern: high-cardinality time-series ingestion with rollups and query fan-out
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: validate and shard samples, persist recent series, compact blocks, and evaluate queries and alerts

systemDesignCases.title: Design an ad click aggregation system
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an ad click pipeline that powers near-real-time campaign dashboards and produces auditable daily billing aggregates despite duplicates, retries, bots, and late events.
systemDesignCases.pattern: event-time stream aggregation with deduplication and late-data correction
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: accept a signed click, deduplicate it, join campaign metadata, window by event time, and publish aggregates

systemDesignCases.title: Design a hotel reservation system
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a hotel booking platform that searches room availability and prevents overselling across multi-night stays, retries, payment delays, and expiring holds.
systemDesignCases.pattern: dated inventory holds with transactional confirmation and expiry
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: price a room-night set, place a bounded hold, authorize payment, and atomically confirm inventory

systemDesignCases.title: Design a distributed email service
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a transactional email platform that accepts API requests, renders templates, delivers through SMTP, handles retries and bounces, and protects sender reputation.
systemDesignCases.pattern: policy-aware asynchronous delivery with domain throttles and feedback loops
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: accept one logical message, expand recipients, enqueue by destination domain, attempt SMTP delivery, and process feedback

systemDesignCases.title: Design an object storage service
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design an S3-like object storage service with buckets, immutable object versions, multipart uploads, ranged reads, checksums, lifecycle policies, and regional durability.
systemDesignCases.pattern: immutable blob placement with strongly identified metadata and background repair
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: authorize a multipart upload, place erasure-coded chunks, commit metadata, and serve ranged reads

systemDesignCases.title: Design a real-time gaming leaderboard
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a leaderboard for a global game with seasonal, regional, and friends-only rankings, real-time score updates, anti-cheat review, and stable end-of-season results.
systemDesignCases.pattern: ordered score index with idempotent event updates and rank snapshots
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: validate a score event, update the ordered index, and answer top-N and around-player ranks

systemDesignCases.title: Design a digital wallet
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design a digital wallet that supports deposits, peer-to-peer transfers, merchant payments, refunds, and withdrawals while maintaining auditable balances across retries and external settlement.
systemDesignCases.pattern: double-entry value transfer with holds, idempotent commands, and reconciliation
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: authorize a transfer, reserve funds, post balanced ledger entries, and expose derived balances

systemDesignCases.title: Design a stock exchange
systemDesignCases.prompt: Design the core of a stock exchange that accepts limit and market orders, matches by price-time priority, publishes market data, and recovers without reordering or duplicating trades.
systemDesignCases.pattern: single-writer price-time priority matching with sequenced market-data replication
systemDesignCases.criticalPath: risk-check and sequence an order, mutate one symbol book, emit trades, and publish ordered market data
